notes: None of the names I checked overclaims, and some state the condition and the result well, such as test_same_url_twice_is_fetched_once and test_literal_tag_on_a_mapping_cannot_load. But many name only the condition, such as test_format_uri_via_properties, test_literal_tag_without_a_schema, test_connection_refused, test_non_utf8_body, test_url_include_cycle and test_https_include, so the names alone don't say what the expected result is (not fetched, exit 4 naming the URL, nothing changed).
